# Pride World City — 400-Acre Integrated Mega Township Advisory Portal (Charholi Budruk, Pune)

> Pride World City (Charholi Budruk, PIN 412105) is a 400-acre integrated mega township developed by Pride Group in North Pune, Maharashtra, India. This informational portal is operated by Propsmart Realty (Authorized Channel Partner). Situated 10 minutes (4.8 km) from Pune International Airport and 18 minutes (11 km) from Kharadi EON IT Park, it spans 5+ million sq. ft. of completed development and 8+ million sq. ft. under construction.

## Key Township Metrics
- **Developer:** Pride Group (Pride Developers Pune), 28+ years legacy, led by MD Arvind Jain
- **Location:** Adjacent to D.Y. Patil Knowledge City, Charholi Budruk, Pune - 412105
- **Coordinates:** 18.6366° N, 73.8967° E
- **Scale:** Approximately 400 contiguous acres with 70% open green spaces
- **Delivered Footprint:** 5+ Million Sq. Ft. completed
- **Active Development:** 8+ Million Sq. Ft. under construction
- **Community:** 10,000+ families

## Township Civic & Commercial Ecosystem
- **Pride Tech Park:** Grade-A commercial IT & corporate office hub inside the township.
- **Education:** Global Indian International School (GIIS) — Cambridge & CBSE K-12 campus operational inside gates.
- **Recreation:** 50,000 sq. ft. Club Royale / Club Charholi, 7-acre central freshwater lake promenade, 10-acre multi-sport arena.
- **Healthcare & Retail:** Planned 100-bed multispeciality hospital, Town Plaza high-street shopping, 5-star business hotel, and BRTS rapid transit station.

## Connectivity & Micro-Market Benchmarks
- **Pune International Airport (PNQ):** 4.8 km (10 mins)
- **D.Y. Patil Knowledge City:** 0.5 km (2 mins, adjacent)
- **Dhanori & Lohegaon:** 3.5 km (7 mins)
- **Viman Nagar & Phoenix Marketcity:** 8.5 km (14 mins)
- **Kharadi EON IT Park & World Trade Center:** 11.0 km (18 mins via 8-lane link corridor)
- **Proposed PMRDA Pune Ring Road:** 1.8 km (3 mins)
- **Rental Yield:** 4.8% - 6.0% annually (outperforming Pune average of ~3.2%)
- **5-Year Appreciation:** 42.8%+
